risk_description:
The length of the wiring harness of the front wheel speed sensors might be inadequate. As a result, in certain driving manoeuvres such as full steering wheel angle or full compression/rebound of the suspension, damage to the wiring harness due to tensile load might occur. 
This could lead to impairment of vehicle's dynamics control systems increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
